the integrative analysis of 257 neuroendocrine neoplasm samples stratifies atypical carcinoids in two prognostic subtypes with 10-year overall survivals of 88% vs 27%; identifies therapeutically relevant groups of pulmonary carcinoid samples; and unveils the supra-carcinsoids, a group of samples that share the morphological features of the pulmonary carcinoids but the genomic, transcriptomic, and clinical features of LCNEC.
